ADDQ_SUBQ.scope: All 2,656 legal ADDQ/SUBQ words across eight quick fields, three sizes, data-alterable destinations and word/long An; 416 illegal EA combinations; full-width An/no-flags behavior, exact arithmetic flags, ordered memory RMW, extension faults and operand read/write fault suppression.

ADDSUB_ADDRESS.scope: All 1,952 legal ADDA/SUBA word/long words, 96 illegal holes, every source EA and register alias, word sign extension, complete 32-bit results, preserved CCR, same-An address side effects and first/second extension plus operand-read fault suppression.

ADDSUB_IMMEDIATE.scope: All 300 legal ADDI/SUBI words, 212 illegal holes, sizes, EAs, aliases, arithmetic flags, immediate layout, ordered RMW and extension/read/write fault suppression.

ADDX_SUBX_REGISTER.scope: Register form in byte, word and long sizes, including exhaustive byte flags, cumulative Z and narrow writes.

ADDX_SUBX_MEMORY.scope: All 384 byte/word/long predecrement-memory words, ordered source-read/destination-read/destination-write, same-An double decrement, A7 byte alignment, exact flags, and source-read/destination-read/destination-write group-0 fault suppression.

ABCD_SBCD.scope: All 256 register/memory words, exhaustive valid packed-BCD arithmetic for both X inputs, X=C, cumulative Z, deterministic undefined N/V, same-An/A7 behavior, ordered memory RMW, and faults at each memory phase.

NBCD.scope: All 50 legal byte data-alterable words and 14 illegal EA holes; all EA classes and register aliases across valid packed-BCD zero, nonzero, tens-complement and nines-complement cases; both X inputs, both cumulative-Z outcomes, X=C decimal borrow, narrow writes, A7 byte stepping, ordered memory RMW, and EA-extension/read/write group-0 fault suppression.
references: Motorola M68000 Family Programmer's Reference Manual (1992), section 3.1.7 pp. 3-10--3-11
Motorola M68000 Family Programmer's Reference Manual (1992), table 3-18 pp. 3-17--3-18
Motorola M68000 Family Programmer's Reference Manual (1992), NBCD pp. 4-140--4-142
M68000 8-/16-/32-Bit Microprocessors User's Manual, Ninth Edition (1993), table 7-7

ADD_EA_DN.scope: All 1,400 legal ADD <ea>,Dn words, 136 illegal holes, three sizes, every source EA and register alias, exact XNZVC, narrow writes, PC-relative/immediate layout, A7 stepping and extension/operand-read fault suppression.

BINARY_DN_EA.scope: All 5,232 generic ADD/SUB/AND/OR/EOR Dn,<ea> words, 1,408 specialized overlaps and 1,040 illegal holes; exact sized results/flags, all aliases, ordered memory RMW and extension/read/write fault suppression.

BINARY_EA_DN.scope: All 5,344 legal SUB/CMP/AND/OR <ea>,Dn words plus the 1,400 ADD words in its dedicated format, with all source EAs, sizes, aliases, flags, read-only CMP, PC-relative/immediate layout and extension/read fault suppression.

BIT_DYNAMIC.scope: Dn and selected memory forms; complete legal EA and fault matrix open.

BIT_IMMEDIATE.scope: Dn and selected memory forms; complete legal EA and fault matrix open.

BRANCH.scope: BSR byte/word audited; complete Bcc condition and displacement integration remains open.

CHK.scope: M00 signed word bounds, in-range retirement, both trap causes, defined N, following-PC frame and postincrement covered; complete data-EA/fault matrix open.

CLR.scope: All 150 legal byte/word/long words, 42 illegal EA holes, all address side effects, exact flags, M00 memory read-before-write, extension faults and operand read/write fault suppression.

CMP_IMMEDIATE.scope: All 150 legal CMPI words, 106 illegal holes, sizes, EAs, aliases, NZVC, X preservation, read-only memory behavior and extension/read fault suppression.

CMPA.scope: All 976 legal CMPA word/long words, 48 illegal holes, every source EA and alias, word sign extension, 32-bit NZVC with X preserved, no destination write, same-An address effects and first/second extension plus operand-read fault suppression.

CMPM.scope: All 192 legal byte/word/long encodings, every Ax/Ay combination, ordered source/destination reads, same-register aliasing, A7 byte stepping, condition codes, and deterministic source/destination bus and alignment fault checkpoints.

DBCC.scope: All condition equations plus true, decrement/branch and terminal control paths.

DIV.scope: All 848 legal DIVU/DIVS words and 176 illegal holes, every source EA and Dn alias, quotient/remainder layout, signed remainder, representable boundaries, overflow preservation, defined flags, vector-5 following-PC frame with C cleared, and first/second extension plus operand-read fault suppression.

EXG.scope: All Dn/Dn, An/An and Dn/An register encodings exchange complete 32-bit values, including active supervisor A7, without changing any condition-code bit.

EXT.scope: M00 byte-to-word and word-to-long forms, narrow preservation, sign extension and flags.

ILLEGAL.scope: Architected $4afc opcode, vector 4 and M00 faulting-PC frame.

JMP.scope: Absolute control transfer, flags and illegal non-control EAs covered; complete control-EA/fetch-fault matrix open.

JSR.scope: Absolute-long target, following-PC stack value/order and RTS return covered; complete control-EA and injected stack-fault matrix open.

LEA.scope: Absolute-word sign extension, PC-relative base, address-only behavior and illegal non-control EAs covered; complete control-EA matrix open.

LINK.scope: M00 word displacement, old-An stack value, frame assignment, stack allocation and the An=A7 sequential-order alias covered; injected write faults open.

LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE.scope: All 450 legal generic ORI/ANDI/EORI words, six exact-form overlaps, 312 illegal holes, sizes, EAs, aliases, flags, immediate layout, ordered RMW and faults.

LOGICAL_IMMEDIATE_SR.scope: All six exact CCR/SR words, logical results, CCR upper-byte preservation, SR width/privilege and extension-fetch group-0 faults.

MOVE.scope: Byte/word/long register, memory-to-memory source-before-destination, extension ordering, A7 byte step, MOVEA sign extension and flags covered; same-An double-EA and complete fault matrix open.

MOVEM.scope: Word/long normal/reversed ordering, sign extension, M00 predecrement base value, postincrement base override, empty mask and illegal direction EAs covered; complete mask/EA/fault matrix open.

MOVEQ.scope: Eight-bit sign extension, long result flags, V/C clear and X preservation.

MOVE_FROM_SR.scope: All 50 legal M00 word data-alterable destinations and 14 illegal holes; every EA/register alias, unimplemented-bit zeroing, narrow Dn preservation, unchanged CCR, exact memory read-before-write, A7 word step, and extension/read/write group-0 fault suppression.
references: Motorola M68000 Family Programmer's Reference Manual (1992), MOVE from SR p. 4-125
M68000 8-/16-/32-Bit Microprocessors User's Manual, Ninth Edition (1993), sections 6.1.2 and table 7-13

MOVE_TO_CCR.scope: All 53 legal M00 word data-source EAs and 11 illegal holes; every EA/register alias, low-byte XNZVC load, ignored source upper byte, preserved SR upper byte, A7 word step, and extension/read group-0 fault suppression.
references: Motorola M68000 Family Programmer's Reference Manual (1992), MOVE to CCR pp. 4-123--4-124
M68000 8-/16-/32-Bit Microprocessors User's Manual, Ninth Edition (1993), table 7-13

MOVE_TO_SR.scope: All 53 legal M00 word data-source EAs and 11 illegal holes; every EA/register alias, complete implemented SR load, defined-bit sanitization, S/stack-bank behavior, A7 word step, extension/read group-0 faults, and user privilege violation before any data-operand access.
references: Motorola M68000 Family Programmer's Reference Manual (1992), MOVE to SR pp. 6-19--6-20
M68000 8-/16-/32-Bit Microprocessors User's Manual, Ninth Edition (1993), sections 6.1.2--6.1.3 and table 7-13

MOVE_USP.scope: Both directions, all An encodings, A7 banking and privilege.

MUL.scope: All 848 legal MULU/MULS words and 176 illegal holes, every source EA and source/destination Dn alias, signed/unsigned full products, ignored upper destination word, exact flags, single memory reads, address effects, and first/second extension plus operand-read fault suppression.

NEG.scope: All 150 legal byte/word/long words, 42 illegal EA holes, narrow writes, zero/nonzero/minimum-negative flags, ordered memory RMW, extension faults and operand read/write fault suppression.

NEGX.scope: Register/memory, extend input, cumulative Z and read-modify-write behavior.

NOP.scope: Sequential PC, state preservation and in-order synchronization boundary.

NOT.scope: All 150 legal byte/word/long words, 42 illegal EA holes, narrow writes, exact flags, ordered memory RMW, extension faults and operand read/write fault suppression.

PEA.scope: Address-only behavior and selected control EAs; remaining control forms open.

RESET.scope: Core-boundary 124-clock output, state preservation and privilege.

RTE.scope: M00 six-byte frame, bank switch and privilege; injected stack-read faults open.

RTR.scope: Supervisor stack CCR+PC restore; user stack and injected faults open.

RTS.scope: Supervisor stack PC restore; user stack and injected faults open.

SCC.scope: All 800 legal Scc words across 16 conditions and 50 data-alterable EAs, both attainable boolean outcomes, all flags preserved, exact M00 memory read-before-write, extension faults, and operand read/write fault suppression; the overlapping 128 DBcc words and 96 illegal holes are classified separately.

TAS.scope: All M00 data-alterable EA classes, illegal EA holes, extension and data access faults, original-value flags, narrow Dn preservation, indivisible atomic OR, address side effects and the A7 byte step.

SHIFT_MEMORY.scope: All eight word/count-one memory shifts and rotates, all 336 legal opcode words, all 176 illegal EA holes, ordered RMW, postincrement, flags and write-fault suppression.

SHIFT_REGISTER.scope: All 3072 legal byte/word/long register-shift opcode words execute against an independent iterative oracle; 49152 standalone vectors exhaust operations, directions, widths, counts 0..63, X states and boundary operands.

STOP.scope: SR load, privilege, trace priority and interrupt wake.

SWAP.scope: All Dn encodings share verified 32-bit half exchange, N/Z, V/C clear and X preservation.

TEST.scope: All 150 legal M00 byte/word/long opcode words, all 42 illegal EA holes, every legal EA class/register alias, extension faults, no-write behavior, exact flags, A7 byte stepping and data-read fault suppression.

TRAP.scope: All vector encoding semantics, boundary vector and following-PC short frame.

TRAPV.scope: Both V conditions, vector 7 and following-PC short frame.

UNLINK.scope: An-to-SP, ordered long pop, final SP restoration and the An=A7 pulled-value-plus-four alias covered; injected read faults open.
